thread:
Amanda: kicking off canary for release v3.0.0 now. routing 5% to canary-x9 in us-west-2. watching key dashboards for 10m. runbook: <https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/deploy-escape-hatch>
Ryan: copying. I'll monitor errors and tail Gunicorn logs. thresholds set locally.
DeployBot: canary started: canary-x9 -> 5% traffic. To revert: `/deploy revert --to v2.9.8 --id canary-x9` or `/deploy cancel --id canary-x9`
Lina: quick note: follow the "surgical unwind" steps in the runbook (section 3->6). Pin before drain, enable router fallback, and flush prefix caches when rolling back. excerpt: "Always pin prior tag before draining to avoid mixed routing" <https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/deploy-escape-hatch#surgical-unwind>
SRE_Bob: escalation thresholds: 5xx > 1% sustained over 2m OR p95 latency > 700ms for 3m in any region -> initiate backout. I'll own pin + router policy + cache flush.

SRE_Bob: ops checklist snippet:
```
# pin previous stable tag
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/deploys/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"inference","tag":"v2.9.8"}'
# flip router policy to prefer pinned
curl -X POST https://router.internal/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy":"prefer-pinned"}'
# drain canary
/deploy drain --id canary-x9 --timeout 300
# flush prefix/KV cache
/infra/flush_prefix_cache --env prod --target canary-x9
```
Amanda: Teresa added the short release note about the config change to the docs. if we backout, we'll publish a follow-up explaining regression and mitigation for customers.
Teresa: queued customer comms drafts and a quick postmortem checklist in the release notes: <https://docs.redwood/releases/v3.0.0/notes> support tagged for pre-draft messages.
Ryan: opening #incident-deploy-3921 and inviting sec, support, and eng-prods. planning to hold 8m unless thresholds cross earlier.
DeployBot: health snapshot @3m: errors 0.2% (0.2), p95 280ms, cpu 24%. canary continues.
Lina: FYI if we unwind: disable new feature flag `inference_new_routing` and set router to prefer-pinned to avoid split traffic. also coordinate with infra to invalidate CDN if needed.
SRE_Bob: copy. prepping pin/rollback scripts and will post `ops/pin-and-unwind.sh` to the runbook repo when ready.
Amanda: good plan. everyone keep eyes on dashboards and logs. call backout if threshold hit. :thumbsup:
Ryan: will ping if anything sharp pops up, otherwise reconvene at end of 10m window.
